casebody.head_matter:
Christopher D. ALEX, petitioner,
v.
Ray MABUS, Secretary of the Navy.
No. 12-10093.
Supreme Court of the United States
June 3, 2013.
Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until June 24, 2013, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
